verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows event-driven Radar rules evaluated per transaction (block, 3DS, review, auto-pause payouts) and risk thresholds that adjust automatically. Neither is a recurring schedule, and no scheduled-job or cron-style workflow capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
